Default regression views · Eleven automatic checks cover the selected workload across RMWs and transports.
Default viewsManual

REFERENCE RUN · BEFORE
Open run details →
The known comparison point for every automatic check.
$baseline_ref
ROS $baseline_distro · version $baseline_version · run $baseline_run

NEW RUN · AFTER
Open run details →
The run under review. Positive regression values mean it became worse.
$candidate_ref
ROS $candidate_distro · version $candidate_version · run $candidate_run

panels.title: 1 · Complete run status — worst result across every applicable KPI

panels.description: Report evidence is calculated independently for the selected topology; otherwise this shows the legacy threshold-only verdict. N/A categories are excluded and incomplete data cannot produce a passing result.
panels.title: Overall status

panels.description: Worst applicable mean or p95 latency increase. Possible regression at 0.5%; regression at 2%.
panels.title: Latency

panels.description: Worst applicable throughput decrease. Possible regression at 0.5%; regression at 2%. Service benchmarks report N/A.
panels.title: Throughput

panels.description: Worst applicable peak CPU or RSS increase. Possible regression at 1%; regression at 5%.
panels.title: Resources

panels.description: Worst applicable lost-, late-, or too-late-message increase. Possible regression at 0.01 percentage points; regression at 0.1 percentage points. Service benchmarks report N/A.
panels.title: Reliability
Statistical evidence · selected category and uncertainty

panels.description: Statistical report uses repeat-aware evidence for the selected topology. Threshold-only is the legacy point-estimate review aid.
panels.title: Analysis method

panels.description: Number of paired measured trials used by the selected-topology comparison evidence.
panels.title: Measured pairs

panels.description: Worst adverse point estimate within the selected topology and category; units follow the report threshold.
panels.title: Effect estimate

panels.description: Selected-topology lower and upper bounds at the report confidence level.
panels.title: Confidence interval

panels.description: Possible and supported regression boundaries for the selected category.
panels.title: Practical thresholds
2 · Latency and tails — catches slower responses and percentile-only regressions

panels.description: Mean latency as payload grows. Lines make scaling behaviour and the point where two runs diverge easier to see. Lower is better.
panels.title: Mean latency scaling · lower is better

panels.description: p95 latency as payload grows. 95% of messages complete at or below this value. Lower is better.
panels.title: p95 latency scaling · lower is better
3 · Throughput and scaling — catches lower bandwidth and payload-sensitive regressions

panels.description: Worst throughput loss at each payload across matching Pub/Sub scenarios. Positive is worse.

targets.expr: max by (payload_bytes) (100 * (avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_throughput_kb_per_second{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="subscription_throughput"}) - avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_throughput_kb_per_second{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$candidate_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$candidate_run",topology="$topology",metric="subscription_throughput"})) / clamp_min(avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_throughput_kb_per_second{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="subscription_throughput"}), 0.000001))

panels.title: Worst throughput loss by payload

panels.description: Absolute throughput averaged across available Pub/Sub configurations. Blue is reference; purple is new.
panels.title: Absolute throughput scaling
4 · Resource efficiency — catches CPU and resident-memory regressions

panels.description: Worst peak-CPU increase at each payload. Positive is worse.

targets.expr: max by (payload_bytes) (100 * (avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_cpu_percent{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$candidate_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$candidate_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_cpu",aggregation="max"}) - avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_cpu_percent{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_cpu",aggregation="max"})) / clamp_min(avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_cpu_percent{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_cpu",aggregation="max"}), 0.000001))

panels.title: Worst peak-CPU increase by payload

panels.description: Worst peak-RSS increase at each payload. Positive is worse.

targets.expr: max by (payload_bytes) (100 * (avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_memory_megabytes{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$candidate_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$candidate_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_memory_rss",aggregation="max"}) - avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_memory_megabytes{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_memory_rss",aggregation="max"})) / clamp_min(avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_memory_megabytes{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_memory_rss",aggregation="max"}), 0.000001))

panels.title: Worst peak-memory increase by payload
5 · Reliability — catches lost, late, and too-late message regressions

panels.description: Worst run-over-run increase for each reliability signal and payload, in percentage points. Green means no increase, orange needs review, and red is a clear regression.

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (payload_bytes) (max by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_messages_percent{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$candidate_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$candidate_run",topology="$topology",metric="total_messages_lost"}) - max by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_messages_percent{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="total_messages_lost"})), "signal", "Lost messages", "payload_bytes", ".*") or label_replace(max by (payload_bytes) (max by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_messages_percent{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$candidate_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$candidate_run",topology="$topology",metric="total_messages_late"}) - max by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_messages_percent{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="total_messages_late"})), "signal", "Late messages", "payload_bytes", ".*") or label_replace(max by (payload_bytes) (max by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_messages_percent{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$candidate_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$candidate_run",topology="$topology",metric="total_messages_too_late"}) - max by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_messages_percent{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="total_messages_too_late"})), "signal", "Too-late messages", "payload_bytes", ".*")

panels.title: Reliability regression by payload · percentage-point increase
6 · Regression by RMW — identifies which middleware implementation changed

panels.description: Worst like-for-like mean-latency regression for every RMW and payload combination. Each cell contains the actual run-over-run percentage change; positive is worse.

targets.expr: max by (rmw,payload_bytes) (100 * (avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_latency_us{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$candidate_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$candidate_run",topology="$topology",metric=~"subscription_latency|service_client_latency",aggregation="mean"}) - avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_latency_us{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric=~"subscription_latency|service_client_latency",aggregation="mean"})) / clamp_min(avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_latency_us{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric=~"subscription_latency|service_client_latency",aggregation="mean"}), 0.000001))

panels.title: Mean-latency regression matrix · positive is worse

panels.description: Worst like-for-like p95-latency regression for every RMW and payload combination. This exposes tail regressions hidden by a single worst-RMW number.

targets.expr: max by (rmw,payload_bytes) (100 * (avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_latency_us{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$candidate_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$candidate_run",topology="$topology",metric=~"subscription_latency|service_client_latency",aggregation="p95"}) - avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_latency_us{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric=~"subscription_latency|service_client_latency",aggregation="p95"})) / clamp_min(avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_latency_us{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric=~"subscription_latency|service_client_latency",aggregation="p95"}), 0.000001))

panels.title: p95-latency regression matrix · positive is worse

panels.description: Worst like-for-like throughput loss for every RMW and payload combination. Positive means the new run moved less data.

targets.expr: max by (rmw,payload_bytes) (100 * (avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_throughput_kb_per_second{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="subscription_throughput"}) - avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_throughput_kb_per_second{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$candidate_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$candidate_run",topology="$topology",metric="subscription_throughput"})) / clamp_min(avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_throughput_kb_per_second{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="subscription_throughput"}), 0.000001))

panels.title: Throughput-loss regression matrix · positive is worse

panels.description: Worst peak CPU and RSS increase for each RMW. Both are like-for-like run-over-run percentage changes.

targets.expr: max by (rmw) (100 * (avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_cpu_percent{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$candidate_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$candidate_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_cpu",aggregation="max"}) - avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_cpu_percent{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_cpu",aggregation="max"})) / clamp_min(avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_cpu_percent{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_cpu",aggregation="max"}), 0.000001))

max by (rmw) (100 * (avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_memory_megabytes{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$candidate_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$candidate_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_memory_rss",aggregation="max"}) - avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_memory_megabytes{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_memory_rss",aggregation="max"})) / clamp_min(avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_memory_megabytes{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_memory_rss",aggregation="max"}), 0.000001))

panels.title: Worst resource regression by RMW
7 · Regression by transport — separates IPC off, IPC on, and loaned-message changes

panels.description: Worst like-for-like mean-latency regression for each recorded transport mode. Positive is worse.

targets.expr: max by (comm) (100 * (avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_latency_us{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$candidate_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$candidate_run",topology="$topology",metric=~"subscription_latency|service_client_latency",aggregation="mean"}) - avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_latency_us{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric=~"subscription_latency|service_client_latency",aggregation="mean"})) / clamp_min(avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_latency_us{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric=~"subscription_latency|service_client_latency",aggregation="mean"}), 0.000001))

panels.title: Worst mean-latency regression

panels.description: Worst like-for-like throughput loss for each recorded transport mode. Positive is worse.

targets.expr: max by (comm) (100 * (avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_throughput_kb_per_second{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="subscription_throughput"}) - avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_throughput_kb_per_second{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$candidate_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$candidate_run",topology="$topology",metric="subscription_throughput"})) / clamp_min(avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_throughput_kb_per_second{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="subscription_throughput"}), 0.000001))

panels.title: Worst throughput loss

panels.description: Worst peak CPU and RSS run-over-run increase for each transport mode.

targets.expr: max by (comm) (100 * (avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_cpu_percent{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$candidate_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$candidate_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_cpu",aggregation="max"}) - avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_cpu_percent{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_cpu",aggregation="max"})) / clamp_min(avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_cpu_percent{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_cpu",aggregation="max"}), 0.000001))

max by (comm) (100 * (avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_memory_megabytes{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$candidate_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$candidate_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_memory_rss",aggregation="max"}) - avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_memory_megabytes{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_memory_rss",aggregation="max"})) / clamp_min(avg by (topology,process_mode,payload_bytes,rmw,comm,executor,node_role) (ros2_perf_memory_megabytes{client_library="$library",platform="$platform",ros_distro="$baseline_distro",client_source="$client_source",run_id="$baseline_run",topology="$topology",metric="resource_memory_rss",aggregation="max"}), 0.000001))

panels.title: Worst resource regression
8 · RMW comparison — absolute performance on the common IPC-off matrix

panels.description: Mean latency by RMW, averaged over the common IPC-off matrix. Blue is the reference run; purple is the new run.
panels.title: Mean latency by RMW · IPC off

panels.description: Pub/Sub throughput by RMW, averaged over the common IPC-off matrix.
panels.title: Throughput by RMW · IPC off
9 · IPC effectiveness — IPC-on change relative to IPC-off in single-process tests

panels.description: IPC-on mean-latency change relative to IPC-off for the same run, restricted to Fast DDS and Zenoh single-process tests where both modes exist. Negative is better.
panels.title: IPC effect on mean latency by RMW

panels.description: IPC-on throughput change relative to IPC-off for the same run and RMW in single-process Pub/Sub tests. Positive is better.
panels.title: IPC effect on throughput by RMW
10 · Loaned-message effectiveness — Pub/Sub only; not applicable to Services

panels.description: Loaned-message mean-latency change relative to Fast DDS IPC-off for identical Pub/Sub payloads. Negative is better.
panels.title: Loaned effect on mean latency by payload

panels.description: Loaned-message throughput change relative to Fast DDS IPC-off for identical Pub/Sub payloads. Positive is better.
panels.title: Loaned effect on throughput by payload
11 · Like-for-like p95 latency by RMW — selected workload, same scenario in both runs

panels.description: Client-facing p95 latency for an identical 1 MiB, single-process, IPC-off scenario in the selected workload. Each RMW is compared only with itself across the two runs. Lower is better.
panels.title: p95 client-facing latency · 1 MiB ${topology:text} · single process · IPC off · lower is better
